id: \bAfter spending years in this town I decided to help out and teach the move, Endure.
en: \bAfter spending years in this town I decided to help out and teach the move, Endure.
it: \bDopo aver passato anni in questa città ho deciso di rendermi utile insegnando la mossa Resistenza.

id: \bI can teach it to you if you want?
en: \bI can teach it to you if you want?
it: \bPosso insegnartela, se vuoi.

id: \bWhich Pokémon would you like me to teach?
en: \bWhich Pokémon would you like me to teach?
it: \bA quale Pokémon vuoi che la insegni?

id: \bCome back anytime!
en: \bCome back anytime!
it: \bTorna quando vuoi!

id: \rDawn: \PN, are you going to enter a Contest too? Looks like we can share our first time.
en: \rDawn: \PN, are you going to enter a Contest too?  Looks like we can share our first time.
it: \rLucinda: \PN, anche tu partecipi a una Gara?  Sembra che vivremo insieme la nostra prima volta.

id: \rNo need to worry. I won't be upset if you beat me.
en: \rNo need to worry. I won't be upset if you beat me.
it: \rNon preoccuparti. Non me la prenderò se mi batti.

id: \rWelcome. You're just in time to enter our Contest.
en: \rWelcome. You're just in time to enter our Contest.
it: \rBenvenuto. Sei appena in tempo per iscriverti alla nostra Gara.

id: \rOh, you don't have a pass. Here, let me give you one.
en: \rOh, you don't have a pass. Here, let me give you one.
it: \rOh, non hai una tessera. Ecco, lascia che te ne dia una.

id: \rThat will allow you to enter Contests in all of Sinnoh. Come talk to me again if you'd like to enter.
en: \rThat will allow you to enter Contests in all of Sinnoh. Come talk to me again if you'd like to enter.
it: \rTi permetterà di partecipare alle Gare in tutta Sinnoh. Torna a parlarmi se vuoi iscriverti.

id: \rWelcome. You're just in time to enter our Contest. Are you ready?
en: \rWelcome. You're just in time to enter our Contest.  Are you ready?
it: \rBenvenuto. Sei appena in tempo per iscriverti alla nostra Gara. Sei pronto?

id: \rPlease come again.
en: \rPlease come again.
it: \rTorna a trovarci.

id: \rThank you for entering.
en: \rThank you for entering.
it: \rGrazie per aver partecipato.

id: \bFor the Performance Stage I'll be judging your Pokémon.
en: \bFor the Performance Stage I'll be judging your Pokémon.
it: \bNella Fase Esibizione giudicherò io i tuoi Pokémon.

id: \b...Oh? You don't need me to judge. I get it.
en: \b...Oh? You don't need me to judge. I get it.
it: \b...Oh? Non ti serve il mio giudizio. Capisco.

id: \bI see, I see...
en: \bI see, I see...
it: \bVedo, vedo...

id: \bThis Pokémon's potential is outstanding overall.
en: \bThis Pokémon's potential is outstanding overall.
it: \bNel complesso, il potenziale di questo Pokémon è eccezionale.

id: \bThis Pokémon's potential is relatively superior overall.
en: \bThis Pokémon's potential is relatively superior overall.
it: \bNel complesso, il potenziale di questo Pokémon è decisamente superiore.

id: \bThis Pokémon's potential is above average overall.
en: \bThis Pokémon's potential is above average overall.
it: \bNel complesso, il potenziale di questo Pokémon è sopra la media.

id: \bThis Pokémon's potential is decent overall.
en: \bThis Pokémon's potential is decent overall.
it: \bNel complesso, il potenziale di questo Pokémon è discreto.

id: \bThat's my determination, and it's final.
en: \bThat's my determination, and it's final.
it: \bQuesto è il mio verdetto, ed è definitivo.

id: \bIncidentally, I would say the best potential lies in its \v[4] stat.
en: \bIncidentally, I would say the best potential lies in its \v[4] stat.
it: \bTra l'altro, direi che il potenziale migliore sta nella statistica \v[4].

id: \bAnd its Attack stat is also good.
en: \bAnd its Attack stat is also good.
it: \bE anche il suo Attacco è buono.

id: \bI see, its Defense stat is also good.
en: \bI see, its Defense stat is also good.
it: \bVedo, anche la sua Difesa è buona.

id: \bWell, its Speed stat is also good.
en: \bWell, its Speed stat is also good.
it: \bBeh, anche la sua Velocità è buona.

id: \bIts Special Attack stat is equally good.
en: \bIts Special Attack stat is equally good.
it: \bAnche il suo Attacco Speciale è altrettanto buono.

id: \bIts Special Defense stat is good as well.
en: \bIts Special Defense stat is good as well.
it: \bAnche la sua Difesa Speciale è buona.

id: \bIt can't be better in that regard. That's how I judged it.
en: \bIt can't be better in that regard. That's how I judged it.
it: \bSotto quell'aspetto non potrebbe essere migliore. Questo è il mio giudizio.

id: \bIt's fantastic in that regard. That's how I judged it.
en: \bIt's fantastic in that regard. That's how I judged it.
it: \bSotto quell'aspetto è fantastico. Questo è il mio giudizio.

id: \bIt's very good in that regard. That's how I judged it.
en: \bIt's very good in that regard. That's how I judged it.
it: \bSotto quell'aspetto è molto buono. Questo è il mio giudizio.

id: \bIt's rather decent in that regard. That's how I judged it.
en: \bIt's rather decent in that regard. That's how I judged it.
it: \bSotto quell'aspetto è piuttosto discreto. Questo è il mio giudizio.

id: \bLooks like the judges agree. Congratulations, you're moving on to the Battle Stage.
en: \bLooks like the judges agree. Congratulations, you're moving on to the Battle Stage.
it: \bA quanto pare i giudici sono d'accordo. Congratulazioni, passi alla Fase Lotta.

id: \bI'm too old for this. I should quit while I'm behind.
en: \bI'm too old for this. I should quit while I'm behind.
it: \bSono troppo vecchio per queste cose. Dovrei ritirarmi finché sono in svantaggio.

id: \rIs this your first Contest? Don't worry, you've got this.
en: \rIs this your first Contest? Don't worry, you've got this.
it: \rÈ la tua prima Gara? Non preoccuparti, ce la farai.

id: \bThat's the battle. The judges are now giving their scores and...
en: \bThat's the battle. The judges are now giving their scores and...
it: \bE la lotta è finita. I giudici stanno assegnando i punteggi e...

id: \bContestant Zoey wins by a landslide! She'll be moving on to round 2.
en: \bContestant Zoey wins by a landslide! She'll be moving on to round 2.
it: \bLa concorrente Zoey vince con un distacco enorme! Passerà al secondo turno.

id: \rThank you for competing. Please take this as a participation reward.
en: \rThank you for competing. Please take this as a participation reward.
it: \rGrazie per aver partecipato. Accetta questo come premio di partecipazione.

id: \rA Contest judges your Pokémon before you get to move on to the battle rounds.
en: \rA Contest judges your Pokémon before you get to move on to the battle rounds.
it: \rIn una Gara i tuoi Pokémon vengono giudicati prima di passare ai turni di lotta.

id: Yes
en: Yes
it: Sì

id: No
en: No
it: No
